skills.name: commit-message
skills.description: Write git commit messages in this project's format.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for a commit message or asks to commit. Not for editing code, fixing bugs or reviewing changes.

skills.name: changelog
skills.description: Write CHANGELOG entries for a release.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for release notes or a changelog entry for a version.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review a code change for bugs, risks and style.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks to review, check or critique a diff, pull request or staged change.

skills.name: test-writer
skills.description: Write unit tests for existing code.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks to add, write or extend tests, not merely to run them.

skills.name: sql-style
skills.description: Write or review SQL queries following the project's SQL style.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for a SQL query or to change one.

skills.name: api-error-format
skills.description: Design HTTP API error responses following the project's error schema.
skills.whenToUse: The user designs or changes the error body of an HTTP endpoint.

skills.name: regex-helper
skills.description: Write and explain regular expressions.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for a regular expression or what one matches.

skills.name: cron-schedule
skills.description: Write cron schedule expressions for jobs.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks when a job should run on a schedule or for a cron expression.

skills.name: docker-setup
skills.description: Write Dockerfiles and docker-compose files.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks to containerize a service or edit Docker files.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Read, extract, merge or fill PDF files.
skills.whenToUse: A PDF file is the input or the output of the request.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Create and edit spreadsheets.
skills.whenToUse: A spreadsheet such as .xlsx or .csv is the input or the output of the request.

skills.name: email-writer
skills.description: Draft, reply to and polish emails.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks to write or reply to an email.

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.description: Turn meeting transcripts or notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
skills.whenToUse: The user provides or refers to a meeting and wants minutes, decisions or action items.

skills.name: travel-planner
skills.description: Plan trips, itineraries and bookings.
skills.whenToUse: The user plans a trip or asks for an itinerary.

skills.name: expense-report
skills.description: Summarize spending and prepare expense reports.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks how much was spent or wants an expense report.

skills.name: translate
skills.description: Translate text between Chinese and English.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks to translate text.

skills.name: calendar-assistant
skills.description: Read and update the user's calendar and schedule.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks about appointments, free time or adding an event.

skills.name: recipe
skills.description: Suggest recipes and cooking steps.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks what to cook or how to cook a dish.

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.description: Plan workouts and track exercise.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for a training plan or about exercise.

skills.name: slides
skills.description: Create presentation slide decks.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks for slides, a deck or a presentation.
